title: An inline heading retains its module slot owner beside duplicate article text
steps: Run the real-browser inline ownership fixture without model calls or a running customer site.
expect: Visible inline heading text retains DOM sentence order for ownership matching.
The owning module wins over an unrelated article with identical words.
Hidden inline descendants and nested blocks do not form a sentence match.
Atomic text readings and legacy capture support remain unchanged.

tests: inline heading keeps its own module owner
